| Resulting state | Unchanged (read only) |

| Concurrency control | None needed (read only) |

### PATCH /api/v1/organization/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `organization_partial_update` |
| Method and path | `PATCH /api/v1/organization/` |
| Business purpose | The deployment's single organization. Creation happens through provisioning (``manage.py provision_organization``), not this API (ADR-009). |
| Requirements | [HIMS-ORG-002](../../../requirements/organization-and-facilities.md#hims-org-002), [HIMS-ORG-005](../../../requirements/organization-and-facilities.md#hims-org-005) |
| Actor / permission required | `organization.manage` (Change organization configuration). System roles holding it: Organization administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | `PatchedOrganizationUpdateRequest`: `version`, `legal_name` (≤ 255 characters), `display_name` (≤ 255 characters), `default_timezone` (≤ 64 characters), `leave_year_start_month`, `letterhead_address` (≤ 500 characters), `letterhead_phone` (≤ 40 characters), `letterhead_email` (one of the listed values), `letterhead_website` (≤ 200 characters), `letterhead_registration` (≤ 120 characters), `letterhead_footer` (≤ 255 characters) |
| Response schema | 200 `Organization` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | Not taken: repeating the request is refused by the state rules or is harmless |
| Concurrency control | Send the `version` you read; if the record changed since, 409 `STALE_RESOURCE` and nothing is saved; the row is locked while it changes, so two requests never both win |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | `organization.updated` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request; the client should reload before retrying a lost answer |
| Expected error codes | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 409 `STALE_RESOURCE`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED`, 503 `DEPLOYMENT_NOT_PROVISIONED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/organizations/tests/test_letterhead.py::test_letterhead_details_are_saved_with_the_hospital_details`, `apps/organizations/tests/test_letterhead.py::test_a_bad_letterhead_email_is_refused`, `apps/organizations/tests/test_organization.py::test_update_requires_current_version`, `apps/rosters/tests/test_leave_balances.py::test_hospital_settings_set_the_leave_year` |

### POST /api/v1/organization/logo/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `organization_logo_create` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/organization/logo/` |
| Business purpose | Open the logo (anyone signed in; it has no public URL), or replace it. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-ORG-006](../../../requirements/organization-and-facilities.md#hims-org-006) |
| Actor / permission required | `organization.manage` (Change organization configuration). System roles holding it: Organization administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | `LogoUploadRequest`: `file` (required) |
| Response schema | 200 `Organization` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | Not taken: repeating the request is refused by the state rules or is harmless |
| Concurrency control | The row is locked while it changes, so two requests never both win |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | `organization.logo.changed`, `upload.blocked` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | Messages (email; SMS printed on the console until a gateway is chosen): tried at once and logged; a failure never undoes the action; Virus scanner (ClamAV over a local socket; fails closed: SCANNER_UNAVAILABLE) |
| Timeout and retry policy | messages: email timeout 20 s; a failed message is retried every few minutes with a growing pause, up to 5 tries, then shows as failed with Send again; virus scanner: 30 s; if it cannot answer, the upload is refused (`SCANNER_UNAVAILABLE`), never let through unchecked; the client should reload before retrying a lost answer |
| Expected error codes | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED`, 503 `DEPLOYMENT_NOT_PROVISIONED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/organizations/tests/test_letterhead.py::test_upload_show_replace_and_remove_the_logo`, `apps/organizations/tests/test_letterhead.py::test_changing_the_logo_needs_the_permission_looking_only_a_sign_in`, `common/tests/test_virus_scan.py::test_a_logo_with_a_virus_is_refused` |
| Backward-compatibility policy | API v1 rules in [the API contracts guide](../README.md#versioning-and-breaking-changes); CI fails when `docs/api/openapi.yaml` differs from the code |
